items.headline: U.S. Stocks Close Mixed Amid Geopolitical Tensions and Ahead of Key Economic Data
items.summary: The U.S. stock market closed mixed on Monday, October 12, 2026, as investors navigated escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and rising oil prices. The Dow Jones Industrial Average managed to finish higher, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite experienced modest declines, primarily due to weakness in technology stocks. Overall sentiment was cautious ahead of a busy week featuring major bank earnings and crucial inflation reports.

items.headline: eBay Jumps on Analyst Upgrade
items.summary: eBay ($EBAY) surged 4.12% after Morgan Stanley raised its price target and named the online marketplace its top pick.

items.headline: Figs Rallies Following Positive Industry Review
items.summary: Figs ($FIGS) saw a significant jump of 12.93% today, driven by a positive industry review.

items.headline: Ciena Leads Optics Sector Selloff
items.summary: Ciena ($CIEN) declined 9.99% as the optics and photonic products sector experienced a broad selloff.

items.headline: Lumentum Falls Amid Semiconductor Weakness
items.summary: Lumentum Holdings ($LITE) dropped 9.81% today amidst a broader selloff across semiconductor and AI-infrastructure stocks.

items.headline: SanDisk Declines Ahead of Earnings
items.summary: Flash-memory storage company SanDisk ($SNDK) fell 6.98% today, influenced by caution ahead of its earnings report and renewed selling in the memory sector.

items.headline: Week Kicks Off with Focus on Inflation and Earnings
items.summary: Investors are keenly awaiting a busy week of economic data, with September's Consumer Price Index (CPI) due on Wednesday and the Producer Price Index (PPI) on Thursday. Major banks, including JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, and Citi, are set to kick off the third-quarter earnings season on Tuesday.

items.headline: Rising Oil Prices Fueled by Middle East Tensions
items.summary: Crude oil prices surged to $106 per barrel today, driven by escalating tensions in the Middle East, which threaten further disruptions to global energy supplies. Geopolitical concerns added to investor caution.

items.headline: Fed Minutes Signal Potential for Further Rate Hikes
items.summary: Minutes from the Federal Reserve's mid-September meeting indicated a unanimous vote to raise the federal funds rate target range to 3.75%-4.00%. Most officials believe an additional rate hike could be warranted by year-end, maintaining a hawkish stance to combat elevated inflation.

items.headline: Energy and Staples Lead as Tech Faces Headwinds
items.summary: Energy (+1.45%) and Consumer Staples (+1.17%) sectors were among the top performers today, reflecting a rotation into value stocks. Conversely, Information Technology (-1.25%) and Consumer Discretionary (-0.53%) were the biggest laggards, with tech stocks declining amid concerns over AI-related spending and a pivot into other sectors.

items.headline: S&P 500 Marks Four-Year Bull Run, Reaching 1,000 Sessions Without New 52-Week Low
items.summary: The S&P 500 reached a significant milestone today, completing 1,000 consecutive trading sessions without recording a new 52-week low. This marks the sixth longest such streak in the index's history, signaling a sustained bullish environment over the past four years, though the index is considered modestly overvalued.
